<!-- pr-reviewer: 63bbd2bc0f256870909d42a1a580c17dc51299a7 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The head is green and the fix is right, but it needs a merge with current main.

Thank you for the snug-fit fix and the pinning tests. The arithmetic checks out: the new radius is never larger than the old padded-diagonal bound, and the cylinder still contains every vertex.

### What looks good
- `fit_cylinder_about` (`crates/geometry/src/geometry/stock.rs`) rejects non-finite or negative radius and margin, and degenerate bounds, by returning `None`.
- `solid_world_radius_about` (`crates/app/src/model.rs`) uses the same model set as `solid_world_aabb`, so stock and WCS are excluded.
- The UI path refuses visibly when the radius is unavailable (`crates/ui/src/state.rs`, "stock fit refused: models have no usable extent"), so nothing is silently wrong.
- Existing documents keep their stored stock numbers, and `RECOMMENDED.md` records the decision.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` is added in source; the `expect` and `panic` calls are in test modules.

### Local results
**Blocking: the trial merge with current main conflicts in code.** `crates/ui/src/state.rs` lines 2448-2459: main refactored the StockFit handler (`let fitted = if radio == 1 { stock::fit_cylinder(...) }` then `apply_stock_fit`), while this PR changes the `let Some((shape, pos)) = (if radio == 1 ...` form. Per the review rules I did not merge; I reviewed the head as is. `RECOMMENDED.md` also conflicts; that is a ledger file and not blocking.

Head results, unmerged (based on the older main):

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | built, exit 0 |
| geometry (all) | 37 passed, 0 failed (`stock` 10, including `a_snug_cylinder_is_the_revolved_radius_plus_the_allowance`) |
| ui `shell` | 20 passed, 0 failed (includes `a_cylinder_fit_round_a_turned_part_is_snug` and `cylinder_fit_keeps_the_cylinder_choice`) |
| ui `--lib` | 242 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | exit 0 |

The PR's notes about software-GL snapshot diffs and the known `drilling_axial` failure did not reproduce on this machine; I did not run the app-wide suites.

### Requested before merge
1. Run `git merge origin/main` on `issue/230-snug-cylinder`, resolve `crates/ui/src/state.rs` by keeping main's `apply_stock_fit` flow and feeding it the snug fit (`model::solid_world_radius_about`, then `stock::fit_cylinder_about`, with the same refusal message on `None`), re-run `shell` and the geometry stock tests, and push. The conflict hunk is around lines 2448-2459.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. `RECOMMENDED.md` conflicts with main; the maintainer will move the entry to `docs/decisions` when merged.
2. PR #238 (#198) touches the same handler, as the body notes; whichever merges second takes this merge.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 8dfcfd7e8bb97d11501ef8694a527f7d93e819ae -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks @bherbruck. Reviewed at 8dfcfd7 trial-merged with current origin/main (1e60b23, includes #222 and #251): merges cleanly, no conflicts. No build.rs, scripts, workflow or dependency changes.

**What looks good**
- The StockFit handler (`crates/ui/src/state.rs:2487-2497`) keeps main's flow: refusal for from-model stock, `solid_world_aabb` check, then `apply_stock_fit` (undoable `SetStock`, rotation kept, same "stock fit refused: models have no usable extent" refusal when there is no fit). The per-side-allowance path (`StockFitSides`) is untouched.
- Snug radius is the farthest vertex from the axis plus the margin (`model.rs` `solid_world_radius_about`, `stock.rs` `fit_cylinder_about`), not the bounding-box corner radius. It still contains every vertex and is never larger than the old diagonal.
- Numeric safety: no unwrap/expect/panic or indexing outside tests. Non-finite vertex radii are skipped. `fit_cylinder_about` refuses a NaN/infinite/negative radius, and `fit_measures` refuses a bad margin or non-finite/degenerate bounds. `positive(diameter)` stops a zero diameter. A model with no facets gives `None`, so the user gets the named refusal and never a zero/NaN/negative cylinder.
- Pinned by `a_snug_cylinder_is_the_revolved_radius_plus_the_allowance` (geometry), `a_cylinder_fit_round_a_turned_part_is_snug` (R10+2 gives 24 mm) and the updated `cylinder_fit_keeps_the_cylinder_choice`.
- Decision recorded per file in `docs/decisions/230-snug-cylinder.md`; provenance and file-size fine.

**Local results (merged with main)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| build `-p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --no-run` | ok |
| camcraft-geometry lib | 39 passed |
| camcraft-ui lib (CWD crates/ui) | 275 passed, 2 ignored |
| camcraft-ui `--test shell` (CWD crates/ui) | 20 passed, incl. both cylinder-fit tests |
| clippy `-D warnings` geometry + app (all-targets) | clean |
| clippy `-D warnings` ui (from crates/ui) | clean |

There are no app-level stock-fit suites to run.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. The axis is the vertical line through the bounds' XY centre (decision doc says so), not the lathe spindle/G54 axis. A turned part off the spindle axis gets a bar sized about its own centre. This matches the previous behaviour and the doc explains it.
2. The new geometry test places a `use` after a `#[test]` fn inside `mod tests` (`stock.rs`); harmless, tidy if you touch it again.
3. The PR body should carry the `Changelog:` line and end `Fixes #230`; please check it does.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
